usedFor: Airtable can be your content calendar; Eclincher publishes to social accounts. A row can become a live post through “Create Post”, or a new client row can set up a workspace with “Create Brand”.

bestTemplate.name: “Record Created Or Updated” in Airtable, then “Create Post” in Eclincher
bestTemplate.why: It publishes the row's text to selected brand accounts, with an optional scheduled time, so your calendar and your posting stay in step.

watchOut: “Record Created Or Updated” polls and fires on edits, so editing a row after it posted could publish it again. Add a status field and only post when it reads ready.
